'''Wolfe''' is an [[NPC]] who appears during the daytime at {{Location|Teaching Zone}}.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Wolfe:''' So you start learning runes from a young age?
:'''Wolfe:''' This kind of fusional language is so hard to pick up from scratch...

==Dialogue==
:'''Agacari:''' Oh, we don't actually use it for everyday talk.
:'''Agacari:''' We only use it to communicate with the [[Exostrider]], since it's more convenient.
:'''Agacari:''' I can teach you if you want.
:'''Wolfe:''' No, no! I just need to know a few characters for my Archaeology final!
:'''Wolfe:''' Linguistics is way over my head
{{Dialogue End}}
